title: ATLAS-Finance: Benchmarking AI Agents in Realistic Banking Environments
abstract: arXiv:2611.22085v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Professional work involves under-specified assignments, where relevant information is spread across workplace applications and may conflict or change over time. To evaluate how well frontier agents can perform economically valuable work in such settings, we introduce ATLAS-Finance, a benchmark of 100 end-to-end investment-banking tasks across 13 simulated firms. As in real banking workflows, agents must search email, chat, calendars, notes, and files to identify requirements, gather information, reconcile conflicts/updates, and then build complex financial models. Tasks were developed by experienced bankers based on their real deal work and take them 15-30 hours to complete. Agent deliverables are evaluated with expert-authored rubrics (median: 124.5 criteria) covering financial rationale and results, spreadsheet construction, completeness, and formatting. translated_title: ATLAS-Finance：在真实银行环境中对AI智能体进行基准测试
translated_abstract: 专业工作往往涉及规定欠明确的任务，相关信息分散在各类办公应用之中，且可能相互冲突或随时间变化。为了评估前沿智能体在此类环境中完成具有经济价值工作的能力，我们提出了ATLAS-Finance，这是一个包含横跨13家模拟公司的100个端到端投资银行任务的基准。与真实的银行工作流程一样，智能体必须搜索电子邮件、聊天记录、日历、笔记和文件，以识别需求、收集信息、调和冲突与更新，然后构建复杂的金融模型。这些任务由经验丰富的银行家基于其真实的交易工作开发，人类完成每项任务需要15至30小时。智能体的交付成果由专家撰写的评分标准（中位数为124.5项评判标准）进行评估，涵盖金融逻辑与结果、电子表格构建、完整性和格式等方面。尽管智能体完成了所要求工作的相当大一部分，但当前的智能体仍然……
tldr: 该论文提出ATLAS-Finance基准，通过13家模拟公司中的100个端到端投资银行任务，评估AI智能体在信息分散、任务欠明确的真实银行工作环境中搜索多源信息并完成复杂金融建模等高价值专业工作的能力。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces ATLAS-Finance, a benchmark of 100 end-to-end investment-banking tasks across 13 simulated firms that evaluates how well frontier AI agents can perform economically valuable, under-specified professional work—such as searching disparate workplace apps and building complex financial models—in realistic banking environments.
